name: Should I renovate my luxury condo before getting a valuation?

mainEntity.name: Should I renovate my luxury condo before getting a valuation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deciding whether to renovate your luxury condo before a valuation depends on the potential return on investment for those specific renovations. While high-end upgrades to kitchens, bathrooms, or smart home systems can increase value, some renovations may not recoup their cost, especially if they are highly personalized. Discussing planned renovations with a real estate professional can help identify upgrades that are most appealing to luxury buyers in your specific market, such as Coconut Grove or South Beach, ensuring a beneficial impact on your valuation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Renovating before a valuation depends on ROI; discuss planned upgrades with an agent to ensure they appeal to luxury buyers and add value.
